newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nat Forge in U.S. titanium golf deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nat Forge in U.S. titanium golf deal.

text.p: Manufacturing group National Forge Ltd said on Wednesday that a major U.S. golf equipment company plans to use the group's aerospace forging technology in the production of a range of forged titanium golf drivers.
National Forge said it is tooling to produce samples of the new products which are planned for release at the PGA Golf Show to be held in Orlando, Florida, in January 1997.
Volume production of the club heads will commence in January and it is planned that a monthly rate of 50,000 units will be achieved by the third quarter of 1997, the company said.
On this basis the revenue generated by the golf head business should exceed A$15 million in the 1997/98 year, National Forge said.
Design of the new range of drivers is based on a patent for two piece titanium design held by Super Alloy Technologies Pty Ltd which will be the prime contractor for the project, it said.
It did not name the U.S. company.
National Forge shares closed steady at 20 cents.
